questions.text: Assume the hole diffusion coefficient is D_{p} = 8 cm^{2}/s. Determine the hole diffusion current density at (a) x = 0, (b) x = 2 \times 10^{-4} cm, and (c) x = 10^{-3} cm.

answers.text: The diffusion current density is given by J_{d} = e_{D} \frac{d n}{d x} = e_{D} \frac{\Delta n}{\Delta x}

formulas.originalFormula: J_{d} = e_{D} \frac{d n}{d x} = e_{D} \frac{\Delta n}{\Delta x} = (1.6 \times 10^{-19})(225) \left( \frac{(1 \times 10^{18}) - (7 \times 10^{17})}{0.10} \right) = 108 \, A/cm^{2}
formulas.genericFormula: J_{d} = e_{D} \frac{d n}{d x} = e_{D} \frac{\Delta n}{\Delta x}
